searchText: Is it just me or are there large block times on Kiln execution chain? Maybe someone did GPU mine raised the difficulty and then dropped off? Only 5 blocks over the last 2 hours. Looks like it that miner(s) dropped off. I thought the EL testnets use some "permissioned" form of PoW to get around people 51% attacking them We want to run the merge testnets as close to mainnet as possible, so PoW for this one. also faucet doesnt work for me yeah its either down or dry There's like a 1000 pending tx's due to the block times being crazy high last night. The pending should get cleared soon-ish and the faucet will probably be back on track. Bots seems to love the faucet, I doubt 1000 users requested for testnet eth We have a status page for the faucet that can be seen here: https://faucet.kiln.themerge.dev/status Along with the faucet balance 🙂 I have setup geth / lighthouse on Kiln and all looks to be running but I missing attestations any idea what I am missing / doing wrong what number of peers do you have on the beacon node? ah, also "no validators present" in the log All running fairly smoothly now although still missing occasional attestations. Is this normal (the 'failure' logs)? is it missing attestations on https://beaconchain.kiln.themerge.dev/ ? because these looks like just warning messages
